body:

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔
   Have you ever thought Minecraft was too **boring**? 
   If so, you've found the **perfect modpack**. 
   This modpack has about 80 mods that will transform your 
   Minecraft experience beyond recognition!

▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔▔

╭━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╮

 and subscribe yt for more new content: https://www.youtube.com/@LodestoneStudiosOfficial
╰━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━╯

 

This modpack was created to give Minecraft a "cozy" upgrade. It includes around 80 mods, 15 resource packs, and 5 shaders that will transform your world beyond recognition with a slight loss of FPS.

**Features**:                                                                                      
🦌 New animals - lots of new mobs                                                                                          
🗺️ adventure - explore almost 30 unique biomes                                                           
✨ Decorate - Minecraft world generation change                                                                                                                                                     
🛠️ Ambient - lots of new sounds / particles                                                                                                                            
🌾 Animations - better movement for you and the mobs                                                                                                       
🍍 thematic map - Surveyor Map Framework                                                               
🔭 Better afk - type /afkc and see what happen                                                                                       
                                                                                                         
Note:                                                                                                       
It might lag a bit while the world is generating, but it should stop after less than 10 minutes.
